comments.author: BLUE
comments.body:
thanks for reply Guilder, though your answer has thrown a spanner in the works,my friend wants the ornament but has dropped hundreds of qmp trying pull this quest without success =( he has 14.8k fame- i thought he might need about 20k...

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hmm. Well, as long as your friend's done both pre-quests, it ought to appear. Marseilles being a capital city means there's usually a lot of extraneous quests which generate, which can make it hard to get the one you want (unless you've got the "Hide Completed Quests" skill, but that takes some work to achieve). That said, the JP wiki is not necessarily infallible... I wonder. Tried a few other sites, but none of them had fame req listed.

I suppose one other solution would be to have someone who has done the quest make the ornament for your friend. They could even team up and discover/rediscover the Colosseum at the same time, in theory. Hope it works out for your friend!
